note: An example is all multiple-choice QA rows for one video: CapQA stores one row per question (about 5 per video), LongCapQA stores one row per video with a qa_list. There are no timestamps, so the timeline is empty; clips come from Ai2's CC-BY GCS mirror (a requester-pays bucket, so a billing project is needed) and were cut at an arbitrary informative moment, not at a labelled time.
